per_hop.query:
SELECT show.name, host.name, host.total_shows_hosted, guest.name AS guest_name
FROM shows AS show
JOIN hosts AS host ON show.id = host.show_id
JOIN appearances AS app ON app.show_id = show.id
JOIN guests AS guest ON app.guest_id = guest.id
WHERE guest.name = 'Paul Melba' AND show.country = 'United Kingdom';
